RISK-TARGETED SOURCE TRACE (baseline b77e9fd2 lines 24-83): Per-shift counter-offer review loads and maps offers, resolves slot ID from payload, and calls shared acceptShiftCounterOfferService or rejectShiftCounterOfferService. It must not trust offer slot/user IDs without backend ownership checks. Test contract: Negative: another pharmacy's offer ID and conflicting slot allocation; positive: selected offer accepted for eligible slot once. This is not a distinct second-reviewer or executed test.

RISK-TARGETED SOURCE TRACE (baseline b77e9fd2 lines 15-71): Poster actions call shared escalateShiftService, deleteActiveShiftService and acceptShiftCandidateService. The delete call is a direct destructive endpoint, with no local check of paid assignments or attendance and is shared with Vite. Test contract: Negative: delete partly booked/paid or already attended shift, confirm server refusal and correct notice; positive: delete unbooked draft succeeds. This is not a distinct second-reviewer or executed test.

F04-N1 is a backend object-scope bug affecting these member lists even if UI selects the correct visibility. RISK-TARGETED SOURCE TRACE (baseline b77e9fd2 lines 119-149): Poster active shift screen calls payShiftWithPills then loadShifts, or chargeShiftFulfillment and opens the Stripe checkout URL. Payment/slot lock is a server-managed lifecycle; checkout can outlive the shift if it is deleted via the same page, as F08-N3 documents. Test contract: Negative: delete after opening checkout; concurrent payment/offer acceptance; positive: valid paid offer finalized once with durable record. This is not a distinct second-reviewer or executed test.
